dossier.headline: Optimist, New York Times bestselling author of "Start with Why" and "The Infinite Game", and founder of The Optimism Company
dossier.about: Simon Sinek is an unshakable optimist who believes in a bright future and our ability to build it together. Simon's WHY is to inspire people to do what inspires them so that, together, each of us can change our world for the better. With a vision to change the way businesses think, act, and operate, Simon and his team work with leaders and organizations in nearly every industry to help transform company culture and create a better working world. As a trained ethnographer, Simon has discovered remarkable patterns about how the greatest leaders and organizations think, act, and communicate. He is fascinated by the people and organizations that make the greatest, lasting impact on the world. He has devoted his life to sharing his thinking, and leading a movement to inspire people to do the things that inspire them. Simon may be best known for popularizing the concept of WHY in his first Ted Talk in 2009. It has since become one of the most watched talks of all time on TED.com, with 37+ million views. Simon is a bestselling author and shares his ideas in the books Start With Why, Leaders Eat Last, Together Is Better, Find Your Why, and The Infinite Game. Learn more at simonsinek.com.
dossier.location: New York, New York, United States
dossier.bio: To run & jump & laugh & cry & love & hope & imagine...to experience as much as I can for one purpose: to inspire.🇺🇦 Founder of The Optimism Company

If you're looking for a sign to try that new thing you've been putting off, this is it. Take a cue from @roblowe and say, "You know what... screw it," then see what happens. You may surprise yourself. 🎧 Catch up on all episodes of A Bit of Optimism wherever you get your podcasts.
What’s your why? @simonsinek is here to help you answer that question. Watch @oprah’s conversation with the bestselling author, presented by @att, on Prime Video, YouTube, or wherever you podcast.
The best leaders start with this question. Watch @oprah’s conversation with @simonsinek, presented by our friends at @GEICO, on Prime Video, YouTube, or wherever you podcast.

@lifeshopny founder Alex Simon (@alex_____simon) reminds us that an apology might not feel perfect or genuine before you say it. But it’s important to start. 🎧 While A Bit of Optimism is on hiatus, catch up on all the latest episodes, including our Feelings at Work special miniseries, wherever you get your podcasts.

@simonsinek’s landmark bestselling book “Start with Why” transformed how leaders, entrepreneurs and employees think - inspiring them to shift their focus from what they do to why they do it. In this episode, @oprah and Simon talk about how to feel more energized, optimistic and engaged in your work and life - especially at times of high anxiety and uncertainty. Watch their conversation on Prime Video, YouTube, or wherever you podcast.
